status: Approved by the project owner on 2026-11-14 and frozen; SHA-256 recorded in scripts/run_confirmation.py
question: On the reserved v2 test blocks, scored once, do the paper's block-holdout claims hold on fresh sentences?

changes_v2_commitment.v2_test_policy: Score a model and its matched controls once on test blocks only if that model passes the gate; otherwise never score test blocks
changes_v2_commitment.why_changed: This plan tests pre-stated claims about controls with frozen pipelines and adds no model, feature or setting. Must be reported in the paper with the v2 rule quoted

test_zone.source: v2 split, seed 42: block 25, buffer 10, 2 validation and 2 test blocks per release

scored.note: 15 of the 100 v2 test-block sentences are v1 test sentences, which stay closed, so 85 are scored

training.rows: All usable rows outside the test zone, from both releases; v1 test sentences stay closed
training.alpha: Chosen inside training data exactly as in each source pipeline

pipelines.rule: Settings are reused unchanged; only the layout differs

primary_score: Expected 10-way top-1 within the query's own block (20 to 24 candidates per query after v1 test sentences are removed), all readers averaged, equal weight per sentence, ties are misses; chance 10%. Scoring as in each source pipeline

intervals.block_resampling: Not used: 4 blocks are too few; block scores reported as they are

C1_eeg_not_above_noise.test: Real minus matched noise for v5, v6 and v9

C2_gaze_beats_word_locked.test: Gaze and word properties minus real word-locked EEG (v6)

C3_eeg_adds_little_to_gaze.test: Gaze plus real minus gaze plus noise (v9)
C3_eeg_adds_little_to_gaze.confirmed: Sentence and reader upper bounds both below 3 points

claims.clear: Gap at least 2 points and every available sentence and reader lower bound above 0 (the v6 gaze comparison has a sentence interval only)

secondary: Position, timing, shuffled pairs and partial check for each pipeline
Reader count 1, 2, 4, 8 and all, real and noise
v9 time bins and anterior removal
New readers: fit on half of each release's readers, average the other half, on the same test blocks
Each pipeline's development score beside its test score
checks_before_running: Synthetic tests: no test-zone or buffer row in any fit; every fold's training excludes the whole zone; position-only and duration-only signals cannot contradict C1; a planted signal is found
Each reused pipeline, run on its old layout, reproduces its frozen development result exactly
Leakage audit refuses to run on any failure
Hashes of existing results, manifests and caches recorded before and checked after
stop_rule: Score once. No reruns or added arms, settings or pipelines under this plan, whatever the outcome
input_checks: Before any score, rebuilt v5 features and v6 word rows for rows outside the test zone must equal the stored ones exactly; word embeddings reuse the v6 vectors and encode only new word types
